from.name: IEEE/IANA assigned wire-number identities
from.revision: EtherType and IP Protocol Number registries

to.name: Linux ETH_P_* and IPPROTO_* symbolic constants

property: globally coordinated wire numbers are copied into operating-system source/UAPI constants so packet dispatch and applications can refer to stable symbolic names.

sources.supports: EtherType identities embodied as source constants
IP protocol identities embodied as source constants

negative_claims: Presence of a Linux constant does not prove IEEE or IANA assignment authority for that value.
Some constants are local, de-facto or explicitly unregistered.
open_questions: Build a per-constant provenance matrix against official registries.
